newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Health to expand in Philadelphia - paper.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Health to expand in Philadelphia - paper.

text.p: The Allegheny Health, Education & Research Foundation plans to spend about $100 million as part of a major expansion in Philadelphia, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Tuesday.
Allegheny said it would build a $40 million outpatient care complex and a $65 million power plant at the former Hahnemann University campus in the city, the newspaper said.
The expansion would be one of the largest Center City construction projects since the late 1980s. The project is expected to be completed in two years, and would add about 500 jobs to the city.
